title: T7-T11 ROM after facetectomy at T8-T9 (with rib cage) (Lubelski 2014)

quantity.name: ROM
quantity.definition: intrinsic T7-T11 rotation range (bilateral, full range) at peak +/-5 Nm, robot-controlled pure moment, ISB coordinate system

source.authors: Lubelski D, Healy AT, Mageswaran P, Benzel EC, Mroz TE
source.sample: 10 fresh-frozen human C7-L1 thoracic torsos with sternum, ribs and all articulations (decompression at T8-T9)

protocol.summary: C7-L1 torso with sternum and rib cage; C7-T1 and T12-L1 potted; KUKA robot applies pure moments +/-5 Nm in FE, LB, AR with active minimisation of off-axis loads (unconstrained coupled motion), preconditioned; Optotrak smart markers on spinous processes. Sequential decompression at T8-T9.
how_to_simulate: Model C7-L1 with full rib cage and sternum; fix the caudal end
Apply cumulative resection at T8-T9 up to this step (see resection.sequence)
Apply pure moment +/-5 Nm (no preload) in FE, LB, AR
protocol.notes: Intrinsic segment measured only in a subset (7 specimens). '6' in the text layer = '+/-'.

extraction.check_notes: Parsed from text layer; global T8-T9 values identical in Lubelski Tables 2 and 4, intrinsic in Tables 3 and 5.

ribcage.intact_structures: full rib cage with sternum; costovertebral/costotransverse joints except where removed by the costotransversectomy step

loading.device: KUKA industrial robot + ATI Gamma F/T sensor, Optotrak

sequence: + unilateral costotransversectomy (transverse process, pedicle, 3-4 cm rib with its articulations)
